## About Eldeco Group
Eldeco Group has been developing residential projects across North India since 1985, with 175+ projects delivered and 30,000+ satisfied customers (as stated on the official Eldeco website). This site lists only its projects in Noida, Greater Noida and Yamuna Expressway.
